quests.name: Timbermaw Ally
quests.text: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.

quests.name: What Niby Commands
quests.text: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: A Husband's Last Battle
quests.text: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

quests.name: Forces of Jaedenar
quests.text: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
quests.text: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
quests.text: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Hot and Itchy
quests.text: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: The Wrong Stuff
quests.text: Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Trolls of a Feather
quests.text: Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.

quests.name: Materials of Significance
quests.text: Use the hints in Gregory's Note to determine where to find the magical components needed for the ritual. You will need help from allies for this.

quests.name: Verifying the Corruption
quests.text: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

objectives.text: Explore the craters in Shatter Scar Vale

quests.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
quests.text: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Flute of Xavaric
quests.text: Bring the Flute of Xavaric and 5 Jadefire Felbind samples to Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
quests.text: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

quests.name: Felbound Ancients
quests.text: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

quests.name: Purified!
quests.text: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

quests.name: Well of Corruption
quests.text: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

quests.name: Corrupted Sabers
quests.text: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.  Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

objectives.text: Return the corrupted cat to Winna Hazzard

quests.name: Further Corruption
quests.text: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

quests.name: Deadwood of the North
quests.text: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Speak to Nafien
quests.text: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Speak to Salfa
quests.text: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
quests.text: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
quests.text: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
quests.text: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

quests.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
quests.text: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

quests.name: Stag Lord's Bauble
quests.text: Take the Stag Lord's Bauble to someone in Talonbranch Glade who may know about it.

quests.name: Stag Lord's Bauble
quests.text: Take the Stag Lord's Bauble to someone in Bloodvenom Post who may know about it.

quests.name: A Strange Red Key
quests.text: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

quests.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
quests.text: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

objectives.text: Protect Arko'narin out of Shadow Hold

quests.name: Runecloth
quests.text: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Sacred Cloth
quests.text: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Flawless Fel Essence
quests.text: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.  The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.  Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
quests.text: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.  Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

quests.name: Ancient Spirit
quests.text: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

quests.name: To Winterspring!
quests.text: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: Retribution of the Light
quests.text: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

quests.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
quests.text: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

quests.name: Winterfall Activity
quests.text: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.

quests.name: A Final Blow
quests.text: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Ulathek the Traitor
quests.text: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Root of All Evil
quests.text: Plant the Demon Summoning Torch in the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's cave in the Winterfall furbolg village. Defeat the demon and retrieve the Essence of Xandivious for Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: The Brokering of Peace
quests.text: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Brokering of Peace
quests.text: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Xorothian Stardust
quests.text: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
quests.text: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

quests.name: A Proper String
quests.text: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

quests.name: Stave of the Ancients
quests.text: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:  Simone the Seductress.  Klinfran the Crazed.  Solenor the Slayer.  Artorius the Doombringer.  Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.  Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.  You MUST complete this task by yourself.
